title: Enroll a WSL distro as its own machine
goal: The WSL distro is a separate machine with its own grants

steps.title: WSL is a separate machine
steps.text: The Linux bridge runs inside the distro. Grants never carry over between Windows and WSL. Paths under /mnt reach your Windows drive, so they are never included unless you name them.

steps.title: Create a code for the WSL machine
steps.text: In Machines → Add machine choose OS Linux, kind WSL, and pick the Windows machine as its host.

steps.title: Enroll inside the distro
steps.text: Open your WSL terminal, download the Linux bridge, and run this. Paste the code at the prompt.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: WSL is enrolled as its own machine.
